requirements: explicit positive application-accepted maximum storage error per represented area
Q1H-compatible conversion implementation and independent verification
no claim of legacy STTAB numerical parity

forbidden: direct STTAB storage-knot relabelling presented as exact
epsilon mode without declared application error budget
admission_effect: G4 configuration guard can qualify before a specific application envelope is chosen; final production admission cannot.

selected_production_mode.rationale: Ribasim is the sole surface-water storage/level owner in the production profile. Legacy STTAB interpolation is not imposed as the physical default of the new coupled architecture.

note: No legacy-STTAB approximation tolerance is needed for the primary Ribasim-native profile because geometry is intentionally Ribasim-owned rather than a claim of legacy numerical parity.
